id: title:eleftheriatrivyzaki:validate email format on the logged out support form

review.posthog_relevance: Adds email delivery and validation checks to the support ticket submission workflow, potentially improving the reliability of support requests submitted by logged-out users.
review.reason: The observed changes introduce shared email delivery checks and an email validation guard into the support ticket submission form. P1.F2.H5 adds AppContext and removes conversation mocks while establishing the delivery guard. P1.F1.H4 and P1.F2.H6 demonstrate the application of this shared check and the use of email validation within the form. This represents a substantive, bounded
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime behavior and complete implementation of the email delivery check are not fully demonstrated in the provided hunk descriptions, and the broader impact on support request reliability cannot be independently verified without seeing the full implementation and test results.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.
